basic_info.description: Lovely single-family home in Miraloma Park featuring three bedrooms, two bathroom, and spacious living spaces. Nestled in a neighborhood setting with access to Miraloma Playground/Park, Miraloma Elementary School, Mt. Davidson, Glen Canyon, and convenience shopping off Portola Drive. This wonderful, move-in ready home has a flexible & functional floor plan ready to suite a variety of needs.  Perfect for entertaining, a graciously sized living room offers abundant windows letting in natural light, and an original fireplace. Adjacent is a formal dining room leading to a charming kitchen with ample storage and access to a sunny patio (great for grilling!). Down the hall are two spacious bedrooms with green outlooks and cedar closets, and a hall bath with a soaking tub and separate shower. An entry coat closet and hallway linen closet complete this functional main level. Downstairs, the lower level hosts a third bedroom with a full bathroom, and an oversized family room with kitchenette/bar area. Off the family room is a walkout deck from sliding glass doors, and  a level, south-facing garden. Additionally, there is a one car garage with great storage space.
